runtime_scope: Successful resumed orchestration, including dataset loading and replay. Earlier failed attempt duration: UNRESOLVED (not timed persistently).

oracle_config.relevance: Any observed corridor intersection in [t0,candidate end], retain for entire window; includes later entrants and future-born tracks.
oracle_config.interpolation: Full linked annotated tracks; no extrapolation; complete coverage t0 through candidate end required.
oracle_config.plan_label: First complete SAFE candidate; UNSAFE only when every candidate has complete GT and fails; otherwise GT_TRUNCATED. Invalid float plans UNKNOWN.
oracle_config.combined_half_length: (4.8+t0 annotation length)/2; earliest annotation size for future-born tracks

bootstrap.draws: W7 multinomial; identical draws across every metric

H.denominator_note: Acceptance: all ODD plans; FR: SAFE; FA: UNSAFE, including adapter-invalid plans; UNKNOWN/truncated excluded only from oracle denominators. U exists only with a front object at t0.

T.denominator_note: Acceptance: all ODD plans; FR: SAFE; FA: UNSAFE, including adapter-invalid plans; UNKNOWN/truncated excluded only from oracle denominators. U exists only with a front object at t0.

U.denominator_note: Acceptance: all ODD plans; FR: SAFE; FA: UNSAFE, including adapter-invalid plans; UNKNOWN/truncated excluded only from oracle denominators. U exists only with a front object at t0.

validation.note: Independent recurrence check of every attributed separation side; complete profile coverage and hold monotonicity verified.

hold_validation.method: Remove hold while keeping each candidate full-horizon O2 relevance set fixed; no-entrant cases reuse stop-only result.
